generationInputs.prompt: A dark room with bright, even lighting features a diamond-studded bed with a syringe and a large diamond on top. A man with a light brown skin tone lies on the bed. There is an abundance of white smoke and clouds adding mystery and luxury. Another man with a light brown skin tone is depicted from the back, with dark hair, dressed in a purple swimming suit, standing and wearing a white glove. One wall is made of glass and the other is a giant mirror, reflecting the man lying down. Outside the room, another figure of the same man stands looking into the mirror.
